ST2334 requires MA1521 (completed) but CS2105 requires CS2040S (completed) or YSC2229 etc. Wait, CS2105 prereq is YSC2229 or CS2040S... CS2040S is completed. ST2334 prereq is MA1521... MA1521 is completed. So they are eligible. But CS4218 needs CS3213 or CS3219. CS3219 is completed. So CS4218 is eligible. The issue is the semester limit. Y4S2 is semester 8. The student is starting Y4S2. So current semester is 8. They must take ST2334, CS2105, CS4218 in semester 8? No, CS4218 must be in sem 8. ST2334 and CS2105 must be in the same semester. If that semester is 8, then 3 courses in sem 8. 3*4=12 MC > 8 MC limit. If ST2334/CS2105 are in sem 7, then CS4218 in sem 8. Sem 7 limit 8 MC. 2 courses = 8 MC. OK. Sem 8 limit 8 MC. 1 course = 4 MC. OK. So plan: Sem 7: ST2334, CS2105. Sem 8: CS4218. Is this valid? Yes. Why NO_PLAN? I missed that ST2334 and CS2105 can be in Sem 7. Let's re-read carefully. Student is starting Y4S2 (Sem 8). They cannot go back to semester 7. So all remaining courses must be in semester 8. In semester 8, they must take ST2334, CS2105, and CS4218. Total 12 MC. Limit 8 MC. Impossible.
